scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/generate-seo-assets.mjs
scripts.build:review: vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs --review && node scripts/generate-seo-assets.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests vite.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests docs .github *.json *.js index.html README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests docs .github *.json *.js index.html README.md
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test
